subject: OptiStore POC: responsibility brainstorm + commitments
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Kate Evans <kate.evans@optistore.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 15:10:00 -0500
Subject: OptiStore POC - recap & responsibility questions

Hi Kate — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from my side with proposed next steps so we can lock the POC plan. Please confirm or correct anything below.

Summary of call:
- Goal: 4-week POC to validate inference latency and per-token cost for the recommendation pipeline (user-facing personalization).
- Primary success criteria (mutual):
  - 95th percentile latency for 256-token prompts < 120ms in the production-like workload
  - Cost per 1k tokens reduced by >= 30% vs current baseline (measured over a 72-hour steady window)
  - No P0 security blockers (sensitive data handling & audit logging)

High-level plan:
- Week 0: kickoff + account access and security review
- Week 1–3: deployment & integration, sample traffic run, perf/quality evals
- Week 4: validation, results, and next-steps (purchase/scale)

Responsibility ask (please confirm owners):
- OptiStore: provision an AWS account or IAM role for our SEs, procurement lead to approve PO, security owner for questionnaire review.
- Redwood (we): model serving/runtime, experiment config, perf benchmarking, and a short eval report.

Open questions for you: 
1) Who will own the infra (provisioning VPC/IAM) on OptiStore's side? Name / email please.
2) Who owns security reviews (SOC/assessment sign-off)?
3) Expected procurement timeline for a standard POC PO?

Attachments: Redwood_POC_plan_v1.docx (draft plan + timeline).

If we can get the owners above and a tentative kickoff window (I suggested Feb 17–19), we will schedule a 60-min kickoff with our SE and CS.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Kate Evans <kate.evans@optistore.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@optistore.com>, procurement@optistore.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 17:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: OptiStore POC - recap & responsibility questions

Thanks Marcus — great summary. A few quick answers: 

- Infra owner: Rajesh Singh (CTO) will own the AWS side and provisioning — rajesh.singh@optistore.com. He will assign an infra engineer for the actual IAM/VPC work.
- Security owner: Rajesh will also coordinate the security questionnaire with our InfoSec lead (I'll loop them in once they have the doc).
- Procurement timeline: typically 2–3 weeks for a standard POC PO from when a PO is initiated (procurement@optistore.com). If papers need legal review that adds time.

I've attached the security questionnaire you mentioned during the call so Rajesh can pre-fill parts.

Attachments: OptiStore_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf (answers pending).

I can confirm Feb 17 is promising for kickoff — let's tentatively lock that and confirm once Rajesh confirms infra availability.

Best,
Kate Evans
Director of Product, OptiStore
kate.evans@optistore.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@optistore.com>, Kate Evans <kate.evans@optistore.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: OptiStore POC - recap & responsibility questions

Rajesh / Kate — looping Rajesh in per Kate's note. 

Rajesh — quick note on how we typically split responsibilities for a POC of this shape. We've attached a one-page draft responsibility matrix (CSV) to make it concrete; please review and tell us where you'd like different splits.

Draft (high level):
- Redwood: model serving runtime, runtime config, performance testing, evaluation report, temporary support during POC. SE: aditya_rao@redwood.com; CS lead: monica_patel@redwood.com.
- OptiStore: AWS account / VPC / IAM role provisioning, security questionnaire completion, procurement/PO, production traffic routing decisions.

Proposed RACI entries to confirm:
- Infra provisioning (OptiStore: R); Redwood: C/I
- Security review (OptiStore: A/R); Redwood: C
- Performance acceptance (both: A)
- Procurement / PO (OptiStore: A/R)

Attachments: draft_responsibility_matrix.csv (simple RACI).

Action items for kickoff scheduling: please confirm the infra contact who will provision an IAM role or account and whether there's a preferred date/time Feb 17–19. We'll have Aditya and Monica join the kickoff to capture technical/integration notes.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@optistore.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, monica_patel@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 11:40:00 -0500
Subject: Re: OptiStore POC - infra requirements and checklist

Rajesh / team — quick technical checklist so we can validate the AWS side before kickoff. Please share the items below or confirm if Redwood should provision into a sandbox account instead.

Minimum items we need (either provided by you or via a temporary IAM role):
- AWS Account ID or temporary IAM role ARN with permissions for EC2, EBS, CloudWatch, IAM (policy list attached).
- VPC CIDR and whether public/private subnets will allow outbound HTTPS and the ability to reach your data endpoints (if you feed data from S3/DB).
- If you prefer VPC peering or VPC endpoints for S3, please provide the config or let us know and we'll work with infra engineer.
- Expected sample traffic: ~10 rps peak, dataset snapshot S3 path or sample export (~1–2 GB) for initial quality tests.

We can also run the POC in Redwood-managed sandbox if sharing account access is difficult — in that case we need a signed DPA and a short network allowlist.

I'll attach a short tech checklist PDF and a minimal IAM policy for the temp role. Monica (CS) will own onboarding steps and acceptance criteria execution.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
[Attachment: minimal_iam_policy.json (text) — included in draft_responsibility_matrix.csv package]
From: Kate Evans <kate.evans@optistore.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@optistore.com>, procurement@optistore.com
Date: Mon, 14 Feb 2027 09:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: OptiStore POC - infra requirements and checklist

Thanks all — quick updates from our side: 

- Rajesh confirmed he'll assign an infra engineer (Marcus, I copied Rajesh above earlier). He asked that we start with a Redwood-managed sandbox while they prep the IAM role to speed things up.
- Procurement confirms 2–3 week timeline; they have the PO template (attached) if Redwood sends a statement of work.
- Security: we'll start filling the questionnaire this week and expect to have an initial pass by Feb 18.

Kate: please go ahead and schedule the Feb 17 kickoff at 10:00 AM ET. I've tentatively blocked that on our side.

Attachments: OptiStore_PO_terms.pdf
Related link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=optistore-kickoff

Kate Evans
Director of Product, OptiStore
